name: zinterp_global_context_static_init
description: zInterp global context static initialization constructs the global parser context with the recovered search/index paths, installs the custom dispatch table, registers process-exit cleanup, and destroys through the base context destructor.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The static-init/register smoke verifies successful atexit registration by return value and leaves registered cleanup to process exit; it does not intercept the CRT atexit table.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x414a60 calls StaticInit then tail-jumps to RegisterAtExit; 0x414a70 passes &g_zInterp_GlobalContext to 0x414ab0; 0x414a80 registers 0x414a90 with atexit; 0x414a90 passes &g_zInterp_GlobalContext to the destructor thunk; 0x414ab0 calls the base context constructor with g_zInterp_PreparedIndexFileName and ".;zbd", then installs g_zInterp_GlobalContext_VTable.
BN data identifies g_zInterp_PreparedIndexFileName as a char* initialized to the adjacent literal "interp.zbd" and the search-path literal at 0x4dae4c as ".;zbd".
Native smokes verify local global-context construction, global StaticInit plus AtExitDestructor cleanup, and StaticInitAndRegisterAtExit initialization with successful atexit registration.
